rule: A24.2 item 2: a Persian-practised practice example is rendered in the English package with the same item's registered English instruction; retrieval unchanged; the A31 capture exemption validates it as that English text
said: When a practice example the planner is shown was practised in Persian, the package must still be English (prereg A24.2). How should such an example appear? -> Show its English sentence (Recommended)
